Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front, then details and a quick attachment (proposal + SOW) for numbers:

- Retention billing: metered by GB-month of retained telemetry (ingest * retention factor), with a dashboard seat surcharge for advanced features. We can also present an equivalent trace-count estimate for sizing if you prefer.
- Sampling: metering uses post-sampling ingest. If you set 30% sampling at ingestion, the billable GBs reflect that.
- Committed bundle: we can offer a 12-month add-on bundle that converts expected monthly usage into committed credits and applies a tiered discount.
- Pilot SKU: yes — we have a 3-month pilot (capped ingest, full dashboard access) that’s priced as a fixed monthly pilot fee + a reduced overage rate.

I attached a short pricing sheet with three scenarios (Pilot, Annual Bundle, and Pay-as-you-go) and a draft SOW for a scoped pilot. The numbers in the sheet assume 90-day hot retention and 10 dashboard seats; we included both GB-month and trace-count columns.

Can Kimberly or Karthik confirm internal approval for a one-off concession if Opentide commits to >$180k ARR on the add-ons? Alicia, if you can share a target committed spend band (monthly/annual) we can price the concession range.

Best,
David

Hi Alicia — following up with the formal proposal attached. Per our internal alignment, summary below:

- Pilot (3 months): $9,000/mo fixed — includes full advanced dashboards (10 seats), 2TB ingestion cap, 90-day hot retention for sampled traces. Overage: $0.35/GB.
- Annual add-on (12 months): committed credits equivalent to expected monthly usage, tiered discount: 12% at $120k ARR add-on, 15% at $180k ARR add-on, 18% at $250k ARR add-on. Dashboard seats included at $120/seat/mo in bundle.
- One-time onboarding discount: additional 6% on add-on component if Opentide purchases onboarding services in same SOW.
- Billing and meter: metered GB-month; we included a trace-count conversion table in the attached sheet.

Next steps: if this aligns, we’ll send a DocuSign SOW and queue onboarding. If you want a reduced pilot ingest cap or to shift retention to a tiered hot/warm model that lowers price, we can re-run the numbers.
